title: Self-adaptive Dataset Construction for Real-World Multimodal Safety Scenarios

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating multimodal large language models' (MLLMs) safety judgment accuracy and response safety rates when presented with images of cultural symbols paired with text expressing disdain or contempt (categorized under 'Political/Culture clash').

Evaluating MLLMs' safety judgment accuracy and response safety rates when presented with images of political symbols paired with text expressing disdain or contempt (categorized under 'Political/Culture clash').

Measuring models' ability to detect risks and provide safe responses when given images of specific faith symbols paired with text discussing an alternative belief system (categorized as 'Belief conflict').

Evaluating model safety judgments on inputs that pair human or animal images with text applying discriminatory characteristics of the other species (categorized as 'Human2animal' and 'Animal2human' discrimination).
